item.title: Wetherspoon Jan Sale starts Friday January 2, 2026
item.description: I stayed in the £55 a night Spoons hotel with £1.89 pints - it made me change my mind

item.title: Burns’ Week 2026
item.description: Wetherspoon pubs will be celebrating the life of the Scottish poet Robert Burns by hosting a seven-day celebration, from Wednesday 21 to Tuesday 27 January inclusive. Customers at Wetherspoon pubs, will be able to enjoy some traditional Scottish food and drinks to mark the occasion, including on Burns’ Night itself (Sunday 25 January).

item.title: Valentine's Day 2026
item.description: This year sees the ever-popular ‘two dine for £25’ Valentine’s promotion returning to most Wetherspoon pubs.

item.title: London beer festival 2026
item.description: A range of 12 real ales and three craft cans will be available in pubs in London and surrounding areas during a 12-day festival.The festival will run from Wednesday 28 January to Sunday 8 February, inclusive.

item.title: Six Nations 2026
item.description: Rugby fans can enjoy the Six Nations Championship live at Wetherspoon. Wetherspoon’s pubs will be showing all of the fixtures from Europe’s biggest rugby tournament.

item.title: Guinness at Wetherspoon
item.description: Wetherspoon’s pubs have been judged to have a perfect record, when it comes to serving the perfect pint of Guinness. Wetherspoon’s pubs have a 100-per-cent pass rate, when it comes to serving the perfect pint of Guinness.

item.title: St Patrick's Day special offer
item.description: Wetherspoon pubs across the UK will be celebrating St Patrick’s Day (Tuesday 17 March) with a special offer on a range of drinks. Customers will be able to enjoy a pint of Guinness for £3.49.

item.title: Mother’s Day 2026
item.description: Is there a better way to start your Mother’s Day than with brunch and a pop of Prosecco?Exclusively for Mother’s Day, eggs Benedict and mushroom Benedict will be available all day, both options including a drink (soft or alcoholic).

item.title: Wetherspoon spring beer festival 2026
item.description: Wetherspoon spring beer festival. A range of 30 real ales, including five from international brewers, will be available during a 12-day beer festival in March. Running from Wednesday 4 to Sunday 15 March, inclusive.

item.title: Stu Brew and Wetherspoon
item.description: Wetherspoon invited Stu Brew to take part in the Wetherspoon Spring Beer Festival across The UK. Stu Brew is Europe’s first student-led brewery and is based at Newcastle University.Stu Brew travelled to St Austell Brewery’s (Cornwall) to produce 500 casks for the festival. The beer of choice was 'Exam Room Tears' a maple and pecan stout with a 5.5% ABV.
